Thanks again for the call today — great to learn about Acme's roadmap for automating support triage and the multi-region latency constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 13:00 ET
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 10:00 CET / Wed 09:00 BST
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 10:00 SGT / Thu 13:30 AEST

Can you confirm who from your side should join the technical session (names + roles)? Also please indicate preferred slot from the attached CSV or use my scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/camila-demo-30m

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer), Aditya Rao (sales engineer), and me. If there's a preference for a longer deep dive (45m) we can adjust.
